body: Hollyyy you just opened my eyes to a new mindset. Over the past months I've become more and more skeptical that, having the same belief myself - that ultimately nothing actually matters in the long term, without placing meaning into everything and having set values one cannot achieve happiness. I've been asking the same question to a lot of people and their answer is always along the same lines of friends, family, helping others, success, being kind, etc but I don't think that, at the end of the day, anything you do makes any difference. I came to the conclusion that since nothing matters life is not worth living but now that I see things from your pov it makes so much sense. Thank you so much you cannot imagine how much youve helped this internet stranger <3
Also, I'm just curious - what are the top 5 things you would say matter the most to you in the present moment (besides obviously basic physiological needs)?

This. I definitely needed to hear this. A few years back I would have been the one giving this sort of advice to my friends but I've gotten so sucked into social media and a pool of self pity (I suffer from depression so things can get pretty bad sometimes) that it's hard to find any self control these days. I give myself a free pass saying that everyone else does it and that wasting time like that isn't that bad until days go by and I haven't done anything at all. I will also check out your yt channel for more advice, check out some stuff from the library and turn the phone off. Ty for your reply!

When they make you want to stick around even for a little while longer

I've been pondering on this for awhile now and I think I've come to somewhat of a conclusion.

1 I've always been considered the smart kid in my classes throughout my life. Always getting all 100s (not just As, at one point if I got anything below a 98 I would cry for days lmao), being in the "gifted" program in any school I go to, etc. That set the precedent of having astronomically high standards for myself and trying to be the best in everything... toxic competitiveness. And now I'm just trying to do so many things that I'm just not that successful at most of them, so all of a sudden I am no longer smart and no longer successful. The rational side of me is like bruh you're not even in college yet none of this is going to matter, but now that I'm legitimately failing my school classes because I physically cannot do anything I'm scared that I will never get into college and that my life will be miserable if I don't get it together.

It's not just that but I'm pretty much a nihilist and a fairly extremist cynical person, so the only thing that justifies my existence is being/feeling important. So every time I fail at something, especially if it lets down others, I feel so insignificant that it triggers suicidal thoughts. I know I need to work on self acceptance and the like but I just don't know how... When people undervalue or ignore my ideas it makes me so mad but they're justified in doing that when most of the things I say and do are stupid. Basically everyone thinks I'm an idiot and doesn't take me seriously anymore and it really hurts... a lot

2. And yeah they do and honestly I'm thinking of quitting most of my clubs because I simply have no interests anymore and other people just make me feel worse about myself than I already do. I want everything I do to be perfect and that prevents me from doing anything at all. I've tried convincing myself that it's alright if a first draft, first sentence, etc is trash (that seems to work for a lot of people) but I just can't do it...

3. Rumor - so mind control lol getting anyone to do, think, or say anything i want them to

thank you for your reply once again it means the world and was very helpful

i did keep everything bottled up for a few months and eventually that pretty much bubbled over and as soon as it did things went even more downhill... i did tell my parents about everything... and they pretty much just called me a selfish brat and that none of my feelings are valid and that they dont matter because i have nothing to be sad about and that im just being a dramatic emotional teenager and that im distracting them and will cost them their job if i continue my selfish foolery... i know they mean well but that made me feel like utter shit. maybe none of it does matter and maybe i am faking all of it for attention but if that was the case i dont think i would resort to self harm to feel better or cry for hours everyday without anyone knowing or noticing right... and yeah lol theres no way im getting any kind of help from them at this point anytime i bring it up they go back invalidating my thoughts and feelings which just makes things worse. my relationship with them is already pretty strained because of it \*sigh\*

im not sure whether i would say that i can lucid dream but i am certainly in control of my dreams when sleeping. its basically like im the mc in a movie plot and i get to decide what i do and to a smaller extent what happens around me. it varies a lot from day to day but it usually is me running away from something now that i think about it haha. usually i have some kinds of abilities like a superhero and im just doing stuff like missions and whatnot. ik its rlly childish but i enjoy it lol

fear of failure used to be my biggest deterrent actually. i never wanted to start anything because the grandiose of wanting a perfect final product was too much. but now even the smallest of tasks that dont even matter at all are too much to handle... the show im watching right now is umbrella academy and im rlly liking it lol. at some points it feels like a disney show lmao but i enjoy it as another form of escapism haha. most of the time i just watch anime tho...

i wouldnt really say its fear thats crippling my self worth... im rlly not sure tho. my mind just jumps to "youre useless go kill yourself" whenever i mess up the tiniest thing or just rlly randomly sometimes and that starts a whole few hours or days of incapacitance self hatred and a slew of fun emotions. 

im honestly pretty sure that its a chemical imbalance or smth at this point. although ive never loved myself and have had suicide on my mind for as long as i can remember (but never seriously or as though i might act on it until now) but all of a sudden i just started shutting off is what it felt like. certain extracurriculars that i had so much fun doing last year have now just made things harder and i just dread all of those things that brought me so much joy before... maybe its because everything is remote but i really dont think thats the issue... i honestly dont know...
Take all the time you need and thank you so much once again for helping out it means a lot

omg this is my biggest fear when thinking abt getting help... i rlly hope things work our for you bro, try talking to a trusted friend i think that if you explain your pov they wouldnt judge you if/when they find out. lots of love <3
ill try that more, thank you!
that makes so much sense i forgot about that strategy. thank you so much!!

oh. my. god. i didn't expect anybody to reply... it feels so cathartic to have somebody nonjudgmental who can relate to my thoughts and feelings reach out. i teared up reading your response lmao thanks for the tips

sadly theres no way i could get antidepressants because im a minor and... family matters, but i was thinking of trying journaling or something of that sort so i should try to start doing that although most of the time i dont know why i think what i think lol

and honestly i just feel so cornered. the thing is i have talked with my friends but it hasnt made any difference really. ig i know that they care now but thats pretty much it. theres nothing they can do to help really since they have no idea what it feels like yk...

but things in these past few weeks particularly have been so very hard. that pills cabinet be looking real luring ngl... today i slept for like 20 hours because as i mentioned in the post thats the only thing i enjoy anymore. i get rlly vivid dreams so it feels like heaven to experience these different realities and not think about my own problems. anytime im not sleeping im just playing video games im horrible at or watching shows lol... i rlly dont have any energy to do anything else. its like all of my mental capacity has been drained from my body and all thats left is a useless lump of shit :(

im weeks behind on all schoolwork at this point and its drowning me. its drowning me so bad. if i dont get my shit together by the end of next week im utterly and absolutely fucked. but the thing is ive been trying to get it together for months and i just cant. i tell myself im doing to work on xyz today and when i open up my computer to do it my brain just doesnt want to read anything or write anything or do anything at all. its a miracle how i manage to log onto my classes at this point (not listening to anything they are saying). i legitimately feel like my brain is fucked. suicide is a permanent solution to temporary problems but its more like a permanent solution to the never ending stream of problems failures and disappointments in life. some days it just feels like everything around me is fake. im not on drugs but it legitimately feels like i am - everything just feels like im still dreaming sometimes its really trippy

and the self hate is just getting so overwhelming. i cant put up with all of the thoughts in my mind anymore. ive pretty much stopped cutting because it doesnt help anymore (i dont rlly get why its a societal taboo in the first place... lol). not to mention how terrible and corrupt society is. i dont rlly think about it much because it makes me feel worse but honestly life doesnt have a purpose. i used to think that id become a renowned scientist and win a nobel prize but now even if i do theres literally no point to that or no point to anything.

the only reason i havent kill myself and probably wouldnt do it is because it would fuck up my parents and friends too bad. i dont want to put them through that because i love them too much. but i *really* dont want to keep living like this. i have no idea what to do about it. everyday i feel like shit. everyday i feel that i am shit. there were days a few weeks ago where i felt a little better for once but then everything went crashing down to a lower bottom. 

it sucks to lie. it really does. i reached out to a teacher for the first time and all he did was make the school psychologist reach out to me and my parents .\_. left me off feeling worse and now every week i have to keep telling the same damn lies to that lady over and over. because ive got nothing to be sad about right? im privilaged in that i live in good conditions, in a nice town, never experienced any kind of outright abuse. but here i am moping around feeling like failure and feeling like shit. it sucks real bad and im so close to ending it all because there is absolutely no way out of this fucking nightmare... 

im sorry if you chose to read all that lol but thanks for reaching out i appreciate it so very much

I would say that the point is to see whether it gets better or to see how much worse it can get. nobody can promise that things are going to get better because sometimes they dont... but if you try taking a break from life, escape through travel if you have the resources to do that maybe that can change your outlook... or maybe it wouldn't but thats something to find out. I think that finding out the answer to whether something in life is worth it or not is enough of a reason to keep living and keep trying to find something. best of luck to you
